body_text: All body prose, review choices/reasons, notes, annotations, media and source remain protected with scope-bound hashes. Changed inside-target associations block an operation.
container_limit: Neither fetched specification nor current tool description attests that a rendered column/toggle/table contains every server-side descendant. Such replacements require explicit complete source evidence; balanced text alone is insufficient.
documented_scope: Tool describes targeted search-and-replace using the smallest exact unique old_str. This supplies a public narrow-edit contract, not a runtime proof of internals.
leaf_boundary_basis: Markdown specification states plain headings have no children. Only exact standalone presentation headings are certified by this adapter without subtree coverage metadata.
